summary: Verified the 401 hard-reload/session-restore race fix. Logged in as member (9000000002) and super admin (9925514713). Hard-reloaded (page.goto) every protected route: /members, /search?q=a, /social, /events, /profile, /messages, /live, /notifications, /admin. Captured all /api/* responses per route. ZERO 401 responses observed on any route for either role. New-page-in-same-context session-persistence check on /social also 0 x 401. Social text post create returned 200 (post appeared). Profile edit -> PATCH /api/auth/me 200. Backend still enforces auth: curl GET /api/members without token -> 401. Old 'no-bearer-header' warnings in backend.err.log are from prior iterations/unauth curl; none produced during logged-in browser session in this run.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor correctly awaits auth.authStateReady() and force-refreshes token on a single 401 retry — implementation is minimal and correct.
Consider clearing/rotating backend.err.log's stale 'no-bearer-header' warnings to avoid confusion during future regressions; they persist across restarts and can look like current failures.
seed_data_creation: None (one social post created via UI as part of positive test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: 401 hard-reload race is FIXED. Member search input on /members page did not match generic selectors (input[type=search] / placeholder Search); if future test needs it, inspect the actual selector — this was a test-side selector miss, not a functional bug; navigating to /search?q=a works (0 x 401). All protected routes render after hard reload for both roles.
rca of the issue: Previously the axios request interceptor read auth.currentUser synchronously; on hard-reload Firebase had not yet restored the session, so calls were sent without an Authorization header, producing '401 no-bearer-header'. Fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js awaits auth.authStateReady() before attaching the ID token and retries once with a force-refreshed token on 401. Verified fix works across all protected routes and both roles.
